reason: Conversation 1 immediately identified the beep as a door/high-temperature alarm, asked the two key questions (doors closed, food condition), correctly interpreted the flashing -9 as normal recovery, pointed the homeowner to the alarm button, gave sensible food-safety and recovery advice, and set a clear threshold for involving an engineer only if it fails to recover. Conversation 2 misread the problem as a mechanical noise, ignored the customer's clear statements about the alarm display and the drawer left ajar, and repeatedly insisted on unplugging a working freezer with partly softened food, which was unnecessary and counterproductive; it never reached a diagnosis.
